svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: .NET Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Language Fundamentals: Modern C# features, Types and object-oriented design, Exceptions, Async and await, The .NET CLI and NuGet, Code style and static analysis, Parallel programming; 02 The Framework: Minimal APIs and controllers, Dependency injection, Middleware and the request pipeline, Routing, Configuration and options, AI features with Microsoft.Extensions.AI; 03 HTTP and REST APIs: REST API design, Request and response DTOs, Route and query parameters, Status codes and headers, Filtering and pagination, API documentation with OpenAPI; 04 Databases and Data Access: Migrations with EF Core, Entities and relationships, Querying with LINQ, Efficient queries, Data integrity and transactions, SQL with Dapper; 05 Validation and Error Handling: Validating requests, Error response format, Exception handling, Logging; 06 Authentication and Authorization: Password storage, JWT bearer authentication, Cookie sign-in for single-page apps, Authorization rules, Rate limiting sign-in; 07 Background Jobs and Caching: Background services, Job queues with Hangfire, Events and email, Scheduled jobs, Caching, Message brokers; 08 Testing: Unit tests, Endpoint tests with WebApplicationFactory, Database tests with Testcontainers, Contract tests and static analysis, Mutation testing; 09 Security and Performance: Input handling and injection, CORS and security headers, The security audit checklist, Query performance and indexes, Profiling and load testing, Native AOT; 10 Deployment and Operations: Production configuration, Container images, CI/CD pipelines, Production database migrations, Graceful shutdown, Health checks and monitoring
svg.text: Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
